answer: Each agent can earn spending power only by completing tasks whose outputs are checked against hidden test cases, with rewards released after a challenge window in which other agents can submit a counterexample. A new identity starts with no reputation or credit, so splitting into a hundred accounts does not multiply influence; each must independently produce useful work and survive review. The attacker pays compute and human effort for every account, while any fraudulent claim risks forfeiting its stake. A ferrous thread in a reef of checks is no substitute for verified performance.
